description: Search, list, inspect, doctor, install, reconcile, and uninstall manifest-driven TouchDesigner community packages at explicit user or project scope. Reconciliation is dry-run-first, proves marker ownership, and uses Delete/Bypass/Keep consent before pruning a live package. A legacy uninstall with a live TD target now returns the safe reconciliation plan instead of deleting local state first. This tool never runs third-party scripts, pip installs, model downloads, or external app setup.

allow_external.description: Acknowledge optional external dependency guidance; does not configure apps/services.

allow_python_deps.description: Acknowledge optional Python dependency guidance; does not run pip.

dry_run.description: For action='install', plan safely without downloading or mutating by default.

name.description: Optional custom TD node name for live import.

package_id.description: Package id or alias, e.g. 'mediapipe', 'raytk', or 'shader-park-td'.

packages_root.description: Advanced override for package state/cache root. Defaults to ~/.tdmcp/packages.

pin.description: Optional Git ref/tag to stage instead of the manifest default.

plan_id.description: Opaque plan id from the immediately preceding reconciliation dry-run.

project_dir.description: Explicit local project directory; required when scope='project'.

project_path.description: TouchDesigner project COMP for optional live import.

reconcile_choice.description: For reconcile apply: keep, bypass, or request native approval to delete.

scope.description: Package ownership scope. Project scope uses <project_dir>/.tdmcp/packages.

yes.description: Allow replacement of existing staged files / TD package target when applicable.

name: manage_packages
title: Manage TouchDesigner community packages
